name: widget2code-benchmark
description: widget2code-benchmark evaluates models on converting user interface widgets (images or structured descriptions) into code snippets or UI component code. It measures how well models can generate correct, runnable code that reproduces the widget functionality or layout. The benchmark is intended for research on UI-to-code generation and code synthesis for front-end components.
reputation: A task-specific dataset aimed at UI-to-code research with modest adoption in the code-generation community.
